issue.title: Cancel tasks with an optional reason from the Ctrl+Shift+P picker
issue.description: In Obsidian, Ctrl+Shift+P on a #task line (bare or counted) or on a dedicated Task Link offers a pinned Cancel row. It asks for an optional reason, then closes the task(s) as Cancelled `[-]` with a `[cancelled:: YYYY-MM-DD]` stamp and records the reason under a managed `❌ **CANCEL LOG**` child. It also removes the tasks' links from today's open Pomodoros, unblocks their dependents right away, and confirms with a rich notice card.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202609/cancel_task_picker.md requests this work

issue.title: Task Status Cycler: versioned dependent-recovery API and cancelled-link guard
issue.description: tsc-recovery-api: expose `api.recoverBlockedDependents` (version 1) from task-status-cycler. Keep a dependent Blocked while it has a strictly future `scheduled` date. When Ctrl+Enter lands on a Task Link to a Cancelled task, show a notice instead of completing the owning Pomodoro. Bump the version, update the README, add tests, and sync to the vault.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/cancel_task_picker.md defines phase tsc-recovery-api as one work unit

issue.title: Navigation Hotkeys: Cancel Log grammar and pure cancel planner
issue.description: cancel-planner: add the `❌ **CANCEL LOG**` marker/entry grammar, a `cancel` managed-log kind (so project conversion carries the log), and a pure batch planner. The planner sets `[-]`, upserts `[cancelled::]`, writes the Cancel Log first-child/prepend/fallback entry, refuses recurring tasks, and returns the cancelled identities. Export the helpers and unit-test them. No UI yet.
